summary: Villagers lose their discounts when relogging while it is a zombie villager
description:
## The bug

When you cure a zombie villager to get discounts, and then turn him back into a zombie villager and then relog and cure him again, it will lose the discounts. They only disappear upon relogging when he is a zombie villager. 

## How to reproduce

 - Spawn a villager and make it link to a work station

 - Make sure to play on hard difficulty

 - Spawn a zombie to turn him into a zombie villager

 - Cure him

 - Use this to command to speed up the process: 

/execute as @e[type=minecraft:zombie_villager,distance=..20] run data merge entity @s {ConversionTime:0}

 - Turn him back into a zombie villager

 - Relog

 - Cure him again and use this command: 

/execute as @e[type=minecraft:zombie_villager,distance=..20] run data merge entity @s {ConversionTime:0}

 The prices will be as they were before, because he lost all of its discounts and then got one single discount through the curing process.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create or open a world set to Hard difficulty.
2. Spawn a villager and have it link to a workstation.
3. Spawn a zombie and allow it to turn the villager into a zombie villager.
4. Begin curing the zombie villager, then run `/execute as @e[type=minecraft:zombie_villager,distance=..20] run data merge entity @s {ConversionTime:0}`.
5. Confirm that the villager is cured and has discounted trade prices.
6. Allow the villager to be turned back into a zombie villager.
7. Use the Esc menu -> Save and Quit to Title.
8. Re-enter the world and begin curing the zombie villager again.
9. Run `/execute as @e[type=minecraft:zombie_villager,distance=..20] run data merge entity @s {ConversionTime:0}`.
10. Observe that the villager's previous discounts are gone and the trade prices have only received a single discount from the second curing.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.2, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 1, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.4, 20w45a, 20w46a, 20w48a, 20w49a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w05a, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w08a, 21w08b, 21w10a, 21w11a, 21w13a, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 21w18a, 1.17, 1.17.1, 1.18.1 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

If a villager is cured after being converted into a zombie villager, its trades receive the expected curing discounts. However, if that villager is converted into a zombie villager again, the game is exited and rejoined while it is still a zombie villager, and the zombie villager is then cured a second time, the discounts from the first cure are lost.

After the second cure, the villager’s trade prices are equivalent to those of a villager without the previously accumulated curing discounts, aside from the single discount applied by the second cure. The discounts remain intact if the game is not reloaded while the villager is a zombie villager.
Expected Behavior: After being cured, a villager’s trading discounts should be preserved even if it is later turned into a zombie villager, the game is reloaded, and the villager is cured again. Relogging while the villager is zombified should not reset its accumulated discounts, and its trade prices after the second cure should remain appropriately reduced rather than reverting to the prices from before the initial cure.
